sections.text_helper: Section 15.3.8 "External interrupt/wake-up lines" in chapter 15 (General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 788.
sections.section_content:
All ports have external interrupt capability. To use external interrupt lines, the ports can be
configured in input, output, or AF mode (the ports must not be configured in analog mode).
Refer to Section25: Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI) for more details.
